title: Hot Step
hints: The vent blasts every other step. Count before you walk.
Let one blast pass, then go.

story.intro: PATCH: "Heatwave. VANTA cranked the Sandglass's cooling into reverse, and now the vents blow fire. They keep time, though. Watch the glow."
story.outro: PATCH: "See? Wait one beat and the heat goes right past you."
